userFlows.name: Select a model and submit a request.

steps.text: The user opens the task pane.
The task pane shows the model dropdown with the current selection.
The user selects a model from the dropdown.
The selector retains the selected model for this task-pane instance.
The dropdown displays the selected model.
The user enters text into the chat input.
The user clicks Submit (the existing Send action).
For each subsequent in-scope model request, the request path reads the current selected model configuration.
The request is sent to OpenRouter with that model configuration.
